source: Minchat Shai on Gen 19:16 (the Mikhlol; the Masorah's seven)

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 19:25 and 19:8 (the Masorah of parashat Toledot)
claim_en: THE EIGHT SHORT THESE: האל ('these' — the demonstrative written without its final he) — the Masorah: EIGHT in the language where האלה is presumed. The overthrow rides a shortened word.

claim_en: קומו צאו ('RISE, GO OUT of this place') — the pair exactly TWICE in the Torah: Lot's sons-in-law at midnight (19:14) and PHARAOH at midnight ('rise, go out from among my people,' Exod 12:31): Sodom's exit-formula is the Exodus' exit-formula — the Kitzur reads the mockers who stayed against those who died in the darkness (named).
middah: E7 (the concordance pair — the same wording at two seats, the Kitzur's reading at narrative strength)

claim_en: THE SECOND DOTTED TEXT OF THIS PARASHAH. At our 19:33 the word 'and when she arose' carries a scribal point, and the chain reads it as marking what he did and did not know: her lying down he knew not, HER RISING HE KNEW. Verified in the ink at derivation. Machine-checked across the corpus: the extraordinary points stand at exactly TEN verses in the whole Torah, and TWO of them fall in this parashah - our 19:33 and gen_34's 18:9 - so the meta-rule stated at the first seat governs the second.
middah: ink (the dotted word; the ten dotted verses counted)

claim_en: THE DIRECTIONAL RULE ARRIVES AT ITS OWN SEAT. The rule that a word requiring a directing prefix at its start instead takes a heh at its end is stated here with its census - the place-names of this block among them - and the objection from a word carrying both affixes is raised and resolved. gen_28 carried this rule at its halakhic seat with our own token in the census; here it stands at home, governing this block's own geography.

check.note: A morphological rule the parse layer encodes, stated at its own seat with this block's place-names in its census.

middah: ink (the directional heh rule at home — the grammatical form)

claim_en: A UNIT OF DISTANCE IS DERIVED FROM THIS BLOCK'S OWN TWO TIME-STAMPS. Reading our 19:15 'as the dawn broke' against our 19:23 'the sun emerged and Lot arrived', the chain computes the DAWN MEASURE: first gleam to eastern light is four mil, eastern light to sunrise another four - the distance from Sodom to Tzoar supplying the span, with the angel said to have levelled the way. Two narrative timestamps of one unit are converted into a standing measure of time and distance still used in law.

check.note: Two time operators in one unit read together to yield a standing legal measure of time-and-distance.

middah: M-05 (the dawn measure — four of the tradition's mil-units a phase — read out of two timestamps and the Sodom-to-Tzoar span; Bereshit Rabbah 50:10)

claim_en: A PENALTY OPENED IN THIS UNIT IS DISCHARGED NINE CHAPTERS LATER. The messengers are said to have been expelled from their station for ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-EIGHT YEARS for revealing the secret - or, on the other reading, for saying 'WE are destroying', the arrogance of the first person - the attribution itself disputed. The arc closes at the ladder of Genesis 28:12: 'where did they return? HERE - ascending, and only then descending.' A numeric sentence filed in this unit and receipted in a later one.

check.note: A numeric penalty imposed in this unit and explicitly discharged at a named later verse - a cross-unit demand and its receipt.

claim_en: THE CITY'S SIN IS READ AS INSTITUTIONAL LAW, NOT IMPULSE. Their practice is quoted as a STATUTE legislated by their predecessors - 'any guest: we lie with him and take his money' - enacted even against Abraham, whose own charge at 18:19 they quote in their stipulation. The wife's complicity is priced the same way: she went begging salt of the neighbours 'for our guests' in order to EXPOSE them, and the pillar of salt answers the salt she asked for, measure for measure.

check.note: A city's offence read as enacted statute rather than impulse, with its own charter quoting an earlier verse of the corpus.

middah: plain (the city's statute; the salt answered with salt, E27, beside)

claim_en: THE CAVE EPISODE IS PARSED BY LEGAL RULES AND ITS MOTIVE DISPUTED. The first-intercourse rule is stated at its seat - conception never follows the first act - and the daughters' procedure is read as a workaround of it. The blame is assigned by grammar: the singular verb is read as isolating the father as the one who sought the act, the daughters exonerated. And the motive of the elder line is a recorded dispute: conception for Heaven then descendants for lust, against conception for lust then descendants for Heaven, with a third reading holding both consistent. Carried dual-track.

check.note: A narrative parsed by a stated biological-legal rule, with blame assigned by verb number and the motive left as a recorded dispute.

source: Onkelos Genesis 19:18; Onkelos Genesis 19:27; Bereshit Rabbah 68:9
claim_en: THE SACRED-PROFANE DISPUTE APPEARS INSIDE ONE SPINE MEMBER'S OWN EDITIONS, AND THE MORNING PRAYER IS INSTITUTED HERE. At 19:18 Onkelos renders the address as PROFANE, 'my lords' - while its own printed variant reads the divine Name, so the dispute gen_34 records BETWEEN the two spine members is mirrored WITHIN one of them. And at 19:27 Onkelos glosses the standing as SERVING IN PRAYER, carrying the same reading by which Bereshit Rabbah institutes the morning prayer from this verse - a second independent convergence of the spine's two members.

check.note: A textual dispute appearing inside one spine member's own editions, and a second independent convergence of the two members on a liturgical institution.

middah: ink (the received translation's rendering)

claim_en: THE PRAYER BOOK'S FOUNDING MACHINE. Yehuda's arms), the evening unbounded by the burning limbs; and the six-hours constant assigned to the heat-of-the-day token at 18:1 against the manna's four. Filed F-113, auto-seated (round 30, the prayer-book block — the Genesis campaign opens).
